card.summary: a network connection plus the ability to host services on it; no storage quota because there is no storage product

free_tier.stated: a network connection plus the ability to host services on it; no storage quota because there is no storage product

egress.terms: donated transit from upstream peers; the wiki is explicit that NYC Mesh cannot detect or prevent traffic monitoring by those upstreams

record.interface_detail: a routed internet connection; you run your own server behind it
record.tooling: standard Linux/nginx/S3 behind your own router
record.chaining: member-hosted services are a stated goal - 'we allow for fast uploads as well as downloads, so members of our community can host content and services rather than only consume them'
record.limits_note: Cost is $240 equipment plus $50 install ($290 total), or $110 plus $50 subsidized ($160 total), plus a voluntary monthly donation. Community ISP network providing symmetric bandwidth and routable IP in the New York City metropolitan area without hosted storage.
record.reliability_note: Depends on donated upstream transit and volunteer installers; no SLA and no redundancy.

evidence.proved: 'We allow for fast uploads as well as downloads, so members of our community can host content and services rather than only consume them from centralized hosts'; 'Average Equipment Cost: $240 ... Install Leader Expenses: $50 ... Total: $290'; subsidised '$110 ... Total: $160'; 'The NYC Mesh network depends on donated transit bandwidth from upstream individuals and companies ... NYC Mesh is unable to detect or prevent traffic monitoring by our upstream providers'
